name: Towel Shoulder Stretch
how_to:
Step 1: Get Into Position
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
2. Hold a towel behind your back with one hand gripping the top end and the other hand holding the bottom end.
Step 2: Perform the Stretch
1. Gently pull the towel upward with your top hand, bringing your lower hand up along your back.
2. Hold the stretch for 15 to 30 seconds, feeling a stretch in your shoulders and triceps.
3. Slowly release the tension, lowering your arms back to the starting position.
4. Switch sides and repeat, ensuring even flexibility in both shoulders.
Step 3: Breathing and Control
1. Breathe deeply while holding the stretch to enhance relaxation.
2. Do not force the movement; work within your comfortable range of motion.
